# miniz inflate decoder

Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
Commit: `2948eebafc5b9f1c69bebed80333e403a09bd62d`.
Only the standalone tinfl decoder is compiled. `miniz_export.h` is the local
static-link build configuration. `miniz.h` is the local standalone decoder
configuration. Upstream license is included in LICENSE.
